annotations.title: Read the high and low season month of an Italian comune

description: Reads the high and low season of one Italian comune: only the month with the most guest arrivals and the month with the fewest, each with its arrivals per resident. Use it to learn when a comune is busiest or quietest; do not use it for yearly totals (use leggi_dati_comune instead) or a trend (use leggi_serie_comune instead). `cod_istat` (from cerca_comune) is the only input: the year is the latest with yearly arrivals (`anno`), and `base` says if its months are ISTAT figures or estimates. Prices are not measured: the busiest month is usually the priciest, the quietest the cheapest. Seasons that cannot be worked out are null with a `nota`; an unknown code is an error saying what to pass. Public, no authentication; 30 requests per minute per client, shared across tools.

cod_istat.description: 6-digit ISTAT code of the comune, as a string with leading zeros kept ("058091" is Roma).

name: leggi_affluenza_mensile

alta_stagione.description: The high season of the comune in `anno`: the month with the most guest arrivals. Null when it cannot be worked out (see `nota`).

indice.description: Guest arrivals of that month per resident (population of `anno_popolazione`), three decimals: 0.5 means one arrival for every two residents in that month.

mese.description: Month of the year with the most arrivals, 1 = January to 12 = December; with a tie, the earliest month.

anno.description: Year of the arrivals the two seasons are worked out on: the latest year with yearly arrivals for the comune. Null when it has no yearly arrivals, no resident population or no territorial profile on the site (see `nota`).

anno_popolazione.description: Year of the resident population that divides the arrivals: `anno`, or the closest year available. Null when `anno` is.

base.description: Where the monthly arrivals come from: arrivi = the monthly arrivals ISTAT publishes for the comune; comune = an estimate, the yearly arrivals spread over the months as the comune's own nights spent are; provincia, regione, italia = an estimate, the yearly arrivals spread with the average seasonal shape of the comuni of its province, of its region or of Italy. Null when the seasons are.

bassa_stagione.description: The low season of the comune in `anno`: the month with the fewest guest arrivals. Null when it cannot be worked out (see `nota`).

indice.description: Guest arrivals of that month per resident (population of `anno_popolazione`), three decimals: 0.5 means one arrival for every two residents in that month.

mese.description: Month of the year with the fewest arrivals, 1 = January to 12 = December; with a tie, the earliest month.

cod_istat.description: 6-digit ISTAT code of the comune, as a string with leading zeros kept.

fonte.description: Source to cite with the figures: processed by DatiTuristici.it from institutional data (ISTAT).

nota.description: Notes in English on reading the two seasons: the months in words, what the index measures, that prices are not measured, whether the monthly arrivals are an estimate, or why the seasons are null.

provincia.description: Province (or metropolitan city) as recorded by ISTAT; null if not recorded.

regione.description: Region as recorded by ISTAT (Bolzano and Trento are provinces of TRENTINO-ALTO ADIGE); null if not recorded.

scheda.description: Link to the comune's public page on datituristici.it, to cite.
